name: Gen2Recomp Dramatic Shape Voxel Mod (gen1recomp)
description: Voxel overworld port for gen1recomp: Red, Blue, Yellow and native Emerald. Select VOXEL in Emerald's Options or Mod Options, or press 3 in the field to cycle cameras. OFF restores the native world. Emerald uses the existing authored buildings, trees and terrain; movement remains grid-based and Emerald staged battles and VR are not yet ported.
